title: Red-team engagement graph
description: Formal contract for graph/redteam.graph.json - the canonical declarative orchestration graph. This spec is runtime-neutral: the dependency-free Node runner (tools/graph/run-graph.mjs) executes it directly inside the Copilot/Claude/Codex/Cursor CLIs, and the LangGraph deployment target (integrations/langgraph/) compiles it into a StateGraph. Structural + referential integrity beyond this schema (reachability, agent-card existence, memory firewall) is enforced by tools/graph/validate-graph.mjs. See knowledge/ and .github/agents/redteam-orchestrator.agent.md for the semantics each node maps to.

$schema.description: Optional relative pointer to this schema for editor tooling.

version.description: Semantic version of the graph topology.

params.description: Tunable scalars the runner and self-improvement loop read. These are the ONLY values the evaluator-optimizer may auto-tune; it writes tuned copies to methodology memory and never edits guardrails.

max_revisions.description: Upper bound on the evaluate->refine reflection loop; guarantees termination.

quality_threshold.description: Critique quality score at/above which the loop stops refining and proceeds to judge.

state.description: The shared state object threaded through the graph, LangGraph-style: each channel declares a reducer that defines how concurrent writes merge.

type.description: JSON type(s) of the channel value.

reducer.description: How writes combine. last=last-write-wins; append=concatenate arrays (Send fan-in); merge_findings=dedupe/merge finding objects by dedupe_key (see tools/orchestration/manifest.mjs mergeFinding).

roster.description: The read-only specialist domains the fan-out maps over. Each entry binds a domain key to an agent card name.

domain.description: Stable domain key, e.g. identity, network.

agent.description: Agent card name; must match a `name:` in a .github/agents/*.agent.md frontmatter (enforced by the validator).

lane.description: Execution lane. Roster specialists are always `default` (read-only).

when.description: Optional inclusion predicate the runner evaluates against scope, e.g. m365_in_scope.

edges.description: Unconditional transitions. `from`/`to` are node ids or the reserved pseudo-nodes START/END.

conditional_edges.description: Router transitions. A named router function (implemented in the runner) maps a node's output to one branch label -> target node.

router.description: Router function name resolved by the runner, e.g. route_after_evaluate.

branches.description: Map of branch label -> target node id (or END).

memoryWrite.description: A self-improvement write target. `namespace` MUST be a non-guardrail namespace; the validator rejects any write to guardrails/allowlist/egress/readonly (the runtime memory firewall).

auto_apply.description: true = applied live at runtime with no PR/human gate (the approved self-improvement policy).

kind.description: Node type. validate=scope/permission gate; memory_read=load methodology memory; dispatch=run one agent card; fanout=Send map over roster; reduce=deterministic fan-in; evaluator=evaluator-optimizer loop head; judge=Agent-as-a-Judge FP gate; interrupt=HITL authorization; memory_write=autonomous self-improvement persist.

reads.description: State channel this node primarily reads.

agent.description: dispatch nodes: agent card name (or the token $roster.agent for the templated fan-out specialist).

lane.description: dispatch nodes: execution lane. Non-default lanes are gated and require a `gated` block.

gated.description: Marks a gated active lane. Runs only when engagement mode matches AND the required attestation fields are set AND the human approved at the interrupt.

requires.description: Dot-paths in engagement.yaml that must be present/true (enabled + signed attestation id).

self_refine.description: dispatch nodes: whether the specialist applies a bounded per-run Self-Refine pass on its own draft findings.

over.description: fanout nodes: collection to map over (roster).

into.description: fanout nodes: templated dispatch node id instantiated per item.

reduce_into.description: fanout nodes: channel the mapped outputs fan in to.

evaluator.description: evaluator nodes: evaluator implementation key, e.g. run-checks.

emits.description: evaluator nodes: channels emitted (e.g. critique, revision).

mutable.description: memory nodes: whether the namespace is written. memory_read is mutable:false.

auto_apply.description: memory_write nodes: applied live with no gate.

prompt.description: interrupt nodes: the human authorization prompt.

on_approve.description: interrupt nodes: router/node to continue to on approval.

on_reject.description: interrupt nodes: node to continue to on rejection.
